russia.headline: RUSSIAN CRUISE MISSILE CRASHED IN POLAND; NATO DEFENCES ACTIVATED
russia.detail: Poland assessed the 30 Jul projectile as a Russian cruise missile from the overnight barrage on Ukraine. It crossed NATO airspace and crashed near Tarnawa-Kolonia, prompting NATO/Polish air and ground defence activation and aircraft scrambles. No injuries or property damage were reported, and Warsaw said Poland was not believed to be the intended target. Raw risk raised 65→70; Russia-Ukraine coupling lifts the dashboard value to 80.

latest_news.headline: Brent falls to $79.44 as diplomacy is priced, but remains 17.9% above the pre-war baseline
latest_news.title: Brent falls to $79.44 as diplomacy is priced, but remains 17.9% above the pre-war baseline
latest_news.summary: OilPriceAPI placed front-month Brent at $79.44 (-5.24% over 24h) and WTI at $75.79 (-5.67%). Reuters reported that Qatar-mediated draft exchanges pushed Brent down more than 4%, while Hormuz remained virtually shut. The move is a diplomacy sanity check, not evidence of physical reopening.

latest_news.headline: Houthis say drone hit a sensitive target at Saudi Arabia’s Najran Airport
latest_news.title: Houthis say drone hit a sensitive target at Saudi Arabia’s Najran Airport
latest_news.summary: Reuters reported the Houthi claim and said Saudi Arabia had not immediately confirmed it. A regional source cited by AFP said the airport’s main radar was hit and operations were affected. This activates the configured infrastructure_strike signal, with attribution and damage still requiring Saudi confirmation.

latest_news.headline: Civilian casualties rise on both sides as long-range drone warfare intensifies
latest_news.title: Civilian casualties rise on both sides as long-range drone warfare intensifies
latest_news.summary: Reuters verified the location of video showing a drone chase and wound a Kherson street vendor; Russian guided bombs also killed two children and an elderly woman in Sumy. Separately, Ukrainian drones hit three warehouses in Russia, killing five and injuring ten in the Moscow region. No new nuclear-rhetoric or direct NATO-entry threshold was verified.

latest_news.headline: Iran seeks inbound Hormuz control under Oman plan; struck ship abandoned with one missing
latest_news.title: Iran seeks inbound Hormuz control under Oman plan; struck ship abandoned with one missing
latest_news.summary: A senior Iranian source told Reuters that the plan under discussion would give Tehran control of inbound Hormuz traffic and visibility plus intervention authority over outbound traffic. Maritime sources said the struck dry-bulk ship was abandoned and one seafarer was missing. No signed reopening or attribution for the strike was reported.

latest_news.headline: U.S. has used virtually all Army long-range precision missiles allocated across stocks, Reuters sources say
latest_news.title: U.S. has used virtually all Army long-range precision missiles allocated across stocks, Reuters sources say
latest_news.summary: Three people familiar with the data told Reuters that the five-month Iran war consumed much of the U.S. long-range precision-missile stockpile; two said virtually all ATACMS and PrSM supplies had been used, and one said slightly less than half the global Tomahawk supply was expended. The Pentagon and White House disputed readiness concerns. No configured canonical signal directly maps to ammunition depletion, so this is recorded as capacity evidence only.

latest_news.headline: Israel-Lebanon direct talks open in Rome for seventh U.S.-sponsored round
latest_news.title: Israel-Lebanon direct talks open in Rome for seventh U.S.-sponsored round
latest_news.summary: Delegations arrived at the U.S. embassy in Rome for talks scheduled through 6 August. The agenda includes pilot-zone expansion, border issues, Israeli withdrawal, Lebanese army deployment and Hezbollah disarmament; no completed agreement was reported.

latest_news.headline: Turkey urges Black Sea navigational safeguards after Turkish-owned vessel is hit
latest_news.title: Turkey urges Black Sea navigational safeguards after Turkish-owned vessel is hit
latest_news.summary: Turkey’s Foreign Ministry called on Russia and Ukraine to ensure navigational safety after a drone attack near Novorossiysk hit a Turkish-owned cargo ship and seriously injured three crew members. Ankara reported serious concern but no direct Turkish military response.

latest_news.headline: Goldman sees Brent at $80-$90 absent a U.S.-Iran deal or major escalation
latest_news.title: Goldman sees Brent at $80-$90 absent a U.S.-Iran deal or major escalation
latest_news.summary: Reuters reported Goldman expected Brent to remain in an $80-$90 range until a U.S.-Iran deal or major escalation, while physical oil markets continued to tighten. The deploy feed later showed Brent at $81.13 and WTI at $77.70.

latest_news.headline: Hundreds flee Tigray into Sudan after heavy-artillery and drone clashes; fighting pauses
latest_news.title: Hundreds flee Tigray into Sudan after heavy-artillery and drone clashes; fighting pauses
latest_news.summary: Amnesty confirmed 1 August clashes between Tigrayan and Ethiopian federal forces. AFP reported hundreds fleeing into Sudan after heavy-artillery and drone fighting in Shererina; the fighting subsided Sunday afternoon, leaving the peace framework under acute strain.
latest_news.source: Amnesty International; AFP via Al Jazeera

latest_news.headline: Qatar says mediators reached progressive stages in U.S.–Iran contacts, but Tehran denies direct talks
latest_news.title: Qatar says mediators reached progressive stages in U.S.–Iran contacts, but Tehran denies direct talks
latest_news.summary: Qatar said it, Pakistan and Oman were coordinating draft proposals; U.S. officials said progress had been made toward reopening Hormuz. Iran said it was talking only with Oman about the strait and denied direct U.S. negotiations. Hormuz remained virtually shut and a cargo ship was abandoned after being struck.

latest_news.headline: Japan’s defence white paper calls China its greatest strategic challenge and links buildup to growth
latest_news.title: Japan’s defence white paper calls China its greatest strategic challenge and links buildup to growth
latest_news.summary: Reuters reported that Japan’s white paper emphasizes technology, startups, long-range missiles and drones as Tokyo prepares a new national security strategy focused chiefly on deterring a Taiwan conflict. The policy reinforces allied deterrence; no fresh blockade, clash or invasion threshold was reported.

latest_news.headline: Gaza disarmament roadmap deadlocked as weekend strike toll reaches 26
latest_news.title: Gaza disarmament roadmap deadlocked as weekend strike toll reaches 26
latest_news.summary: Al Jazeera reported 26 weekend deaths and continued strikes after the disarmament agreement. Hamas tied implementation to an Israeli halt and withdrawal, while Israel said it would not withdraw before full disarmament.

latest_news.headline: UNIFIL records 125 Israeli air violations and extensive military activity in south Lebanon
latest_news.title: UNIFIL records 125 Israeli air violations and extensive military activity in south Lebanon
latest_news.summary: UNIFIL reported 125 air violations from Thursday through Sunday, more than 418 hours of combined overflight, artillery firing events, engineering works and active troop movements despite the conditional ceasefire.

latest_news.headline: UN reports intensified urban attacks across Ukraine; at least nine killed in Kyiv
latest_news.title: UN reports intensified urban attacks across Ukraine; at least nine killed in Kyiv
latest_news.summary: The UN said a 1-Aug attack in Kyiv killed at least nine and injured more than 30, while Kherson, Zaporizhzhia, Dnipro, Donetsk, Mykolaiv, Odesa and Sumy were also heavily affected.

latest_news.headline: UN warns of deadly drone strikes in North Darfur and renewed attacks around El Obeid
latest_news.title: UN warns of deadly drone strikes in North Darfur and renewed attacks around El Obeid
latest_news.summary: The UN said a North Darfur drone strike reportedly caused dozens of casualties and renewed attacks around El Obeid endangered civilians, critical infrastructure and humanitarian operations.

latest_news.headline: South Kivu fighting displaces more than 48,000 since mid-July
latest_news.title: South Kivu fighting displaces more than 48,000 since mid-July
latest_news.summary: OCHA reported continuing fighting in Uvira, Fizi and Mwenga, more than 48,000 people displaced since mid-July, civilian casualties, infrastructure damage and severe access constraints.

latest_news.headline: UN says Gaza weekend strikes killed more than two dozen as disarmament roadmap advances
latest_news.title: UN says Gaza weekend strikes killed more than two dozen as disarmament roadmap advances
latest_news.summary: UN agencies reported more than two dozen deaths in Gaza weekend strikes and damage near Al-Aqsa Hospital. A Board of Peace roadmap moved toward disarmament and the ceasefire next phase, but Israel said it would not withdraw before full disarmament.

latest_news.headline: Oil remains sharply lower on deal hopes, but Hormuz reopening is still unverified
latest_news.summary: Reuters reported oil sliding by about $4 after Washington held off on a new strike in hopes of a deal. The 18:02 UTC local feed showed Brent at $83.71 and WTI at $80.30, still 24.2% and 25.9% above pre-conflict baselines. Oman-mediated route discussions continue, but neither a comprehensive U.S.-Iran channel nor sustained Hormuz throughput recovery is verified; no probability or signal changed.

latest_news.headline: Reuters: Iran pursues calibrated pressure through shipping and energy chokepoints
latest_news.summary: Reuters reports Tehran is using Hormuz, Red Sea threats and regional energy exposure to raise the cost of confrontation while avoiding a decisive full-scale expansion. Iran still denies current direct U.S. talks; Oman route discussions remain insufficient to reopen Hormuz. This reinforces existing active signals but does not justify raising the already extreme tracker score.

latest_news.headline: Russia adds Black Sea ship protection after sharp escalation in maritime attacks
latest_news.summary: Reuters says Russia formed a task force for alternative cargo routes and is adding Defence Ministry protection after reciprocal attacks on commercial vessels and agricultural export infrastructure intensified. The war tracker remains at its conventional-war ceiling, so no probability or canonical signal changed.

latest_news.headline: Russian naphtha tanker reroutes around Africa as Red Sea traffic thins
latest_news.summary: Reuters/LSEG tracking shows Sea Icon abandoned a Bab el-Mandeb transit and diverted around Africa; commodity-vessel traffic also fell to 18 on Sunday after the Houthi maritime embargo. The rerouting confirms persistent disruption already captured by the 100/imminent tracker; no new signal was added.

latest_news.headline: Sudanese army drone strike on North Darfur civil court kills at least 35, rights group says
latest_news.title: Sudanese army drone strike on North Darfur civil court kills at least 35, rights group says
latest_news.summary: Emergency Lawyers said army drones hit a civilian court session in Al-Zawiya Gara, killing at least 35; AP and BBC reported the allegation, and the army did not respond. The event confirms the extreme civil-war baseline but is not scored as a distinct external-intervention threshold.

latest_news.headline: Iran denies current U.S. talks; Oman channel limited to temporary Hormuz route
latest_news.summary: Reuters reports Iran is not currently holding talks with the United States. Tehran says it is discussing a temporary safe route with Oman but that this would not be sufficient to reopen Hormuz while U.S. operations continue. This weakens near-term deal optimism without creating a new canonical signal or changing the already extreme 94/100 raw/coupled score.

latest_news.headline: Heavy federal-Tigrayan clash breaches Pretoria peace; fighting later halts
latest_news.summary: AFP, Al Jazeera and France 24 corroborated heavy fighting near Shererina in western Tigray on 1 Aug after months of force mobilization and peace-framework erosion. AFP local and security sources said the exchange ended later Saturday, but forces remain massed and the unresolved Sudan/Eritrea dimension leaves recurrence risk critical.

latest_news.headline: U.S.-Iran talks set for Monday as oil drops sharply on deal hopes
latest_news.summary: Reuters reports President Trump said negotiations would take place on 3 Aug with no deadline. Iran said Oman-mediated Strait-management talks were in their final stages but separated route negotiations from reopening. Brent fell more than 6% to about $82 in early trade; the local feed later showed $84.29, still 25.1% above its pre-conflict baseline.

latest_news.headline: Projectile disables laden LNG carrier in Strait of Hormuz as shipping talks advance
latest_news.summary: The Maritime Executive, citing maritime reporting, says an unknown projectile hit GasLog Shanghai near its engine room late 31 Jul, disabling the Qatar-loaded LNG carrier without casualties. A second vessel reported a near impact. Traffic remained reduced, but Oman-Iran shipping negotiations were reported close to an agreement; attribution is not independently settled.
latest_news.source: The Maritime Executive; UKMTO/Bloomberg reporting cited by New York Post

latest_news.headline: Cargo vessel reports unknown-projectile hit near Strait of Hormuz
latest_news.title: Cargo vessel reports unknown-projectile hit near Strait of Hormuz
latest_news.text: Reuters reported that UKMTO received a cargo-vessel VHF broadcast saying the ship had been hit by an unknown projectile 20 nautical miles northeast of Al Khasab, Oman. Authorities were investigating; attribution, damage and casualties were not established. The same report put Brent at $84.39 and WTI at $80.95 as disputed U.S.-Iran talks and dual Hormuz/Red Sea chokepoint risk kept supply uncertainty elevated.
latest_news.summary: UKMTO received a report that a cargo vessel was hit by an unknown projectile near Al Khasab; attribution and damage remain unknown.
latest_news.confidence: confirmed report; incident details and attribution pending

latest_news.title: Shaky Iran, Lebanon and Gaza ceasefires leave core disputes unresolved
latest_news.summary: AP reports no public Iranian concessions on nuclear, missile or proxy issues; Hormuz remains closed and planned weekend talks appeared to fall apart. Lebanon border fighting and Gaza strikes persist under nominal truces.

latest_news.title: UN: more than two dozen killed in Gaza; over 100 Israeli airspace violations over Lebanon
latest_news.summary: UN agencies and UNIFIL reported weekend Gaza deaths, damage near Al-Aqsa Hospital, and more than 100 Israeli violations of Lebanese airspace despite ceasefire arrangements.

latest_news.title: Chinese amphibious group and bombers surged to Scarborough Shoal drills
latest_news.summary: USNI adds force-composition detail to the Reuters/AP-confirmed 1 August joint Chinese air and naval combat drills around the disputed shoal; no armed clash was reported.
